messages:
maya.k: quick heads-up — I'm reworking the onboarding lab into a smaller 'greet' app that shows auth setup + one-click deploy. aiming to make it <1 page and runnable in ~5 mins. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

ben.pratt: nice. couple of asks: 1) rename env var to REDWOOD_KEY (we standardized that last sprint) 2) include an npm and python snippet (super tiny)

maya.k: good call on env var. will switch to REDWOOD_KEY. adding py snippet now.

eli: if we're shrinking content, can we drop the advanced caching section and add a link to the Optimize guide instead? keeps the lab focused.

maya.k: agreed, moving caching -> "see also" link. keeping the lab strictly auth -> first request -> deploy.

samir: @maya.k I'll do a quick review after lunch. one thing: the Dockerfile in the PR uses node:16 — can we bump to 20? security baseline.

maya.k: bump to node:20 done. updated Dockerfile and tiny docker run example:
```
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json .
RUN npm ci --production
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "index.js"]
```

ben.pratt: snippet nit: in the JS quick auth snippet use `process.env.REDWOOD_KEY` not `process.env.API_KEY` (matches SDK examples).

maya.k: fixed JS and PY snippets. PY uses os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'] and shows a single request example with streaming off by default.

ci-bot: build/test pipeline passed for docs PR #482 (checks: lint, linkcheck, mdx-compile) :white_check_mark:

docs-bot: spelling check flagged "hella" in paragraph 3 — probable typo.

maya.k: lol thanks docs-bot, removed. pushed updated commit.

samir: reviewed and left two tiny comments on wording in the auth explanation. otherwise LGTM.

ben.pratt: approved. small suggestion: add a one-line troubleshooting FAQ for 401s (token not set / wrong var).

maya.k: added FAQ and a troubleshooting snippet:
```
# if you see 401s:
export REDWOOD_KEY=sk_test_xxx
# or in windows: set REDWOOD_KEY=sk_test_xxx
```

maya.k: any objections to merging after CI? planning to ship this into the onboarding flow next deploy. :shipit:

eli: nope, go ahead. excited to see the condensed flow. :tada:

samir: merge when green.

ci-bot: PR #482 merged by maya.k — deploy job queued to staging.
